name: Composite Cross Domain Variant 9
task:
Please complete the following four-stage multi-domain task.

A hotel chain's annual (25 pages): 8 properties, 70% occupancy, avg rate $150/night. Renovation: Property A ($2M, 15% rate increase), Property B ($1M, 10% increase), Property C ($3M, 20% increase). Budget: $4M.

Calculate NPV of the investment.

Optimize budget allocation.

Recommend the best course of action.
